title: African & Aboriginal Art
welcome_lead: Masks, dot paintings and storytelling traditions.
meta_desc: KS3 cultural art: African masks and Aboriginal dot painting.
final_note: Art tells the stories cultures hold dear.

concepts.def: Face covering used in ceremony or theatre.
Using images to stand for ideas.

walkthroughs.body_html: Across Africa, masks are carved for ceremonies, dance and storytelling. They are not just decoration — they often represent ancestors or spirits.
Aboriginal dot painting uses tiny dots to map landscape, waterholes and Dreamtime stories. Patterns carry meaning passed down for tens of thousands of years.
In both traditions symbolism is central. A shape isn't just a shape — it might mean water, a campsite, or a spirit being. Reading the symbol is reading the story.
